info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Instrument Reference Data Management API
info.description: The Financial Instrument Reference Data Management API provides essential access to market data related to financial instruments. This endpoint enables users to retrieve comprehensive reference data crucial for financial analysis, reporting, and decision-making. Typical consumers include financial analysts, portfolio managers, and risk assessment teams who require accurate and up-to-date information on various financial instruments. This API streamlines the management of reference data, ensuring users can efficiently access and utilize relevant information in their operational workflows.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access and manage reference data for various financial instruments, providing comprehensive details essential for trading, analysis, and reporting.
